liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (4 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer calls this their favorite Bird Song ever, saying it smokes; Bird Song is described as long and great by someone who was present [6][8][10][11][16]
- **Aiko Aiko** (2 reviews): Attendee says Aiko became a group catchphrase after this night, as the show turned crazy from there; When Aiko started, people upstairs formed a circle, holding hands and spinning [12][17]
- **Me and My Uncle** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the first-set Me and My Uncle as surprisingly strong, with Jerry playing on fire [9]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Bird Song into Looks Like Rain was a favorite; by the final refrain it felt like pouring inside [17]
- **Deal** (1 review): Set one closes with a Deal of about ten minutes, with wild guitars throughout the set [12]
- **Saint of Circumstance** (1 review): Lost Sailor into Saint of Circumstance is described as inspired, following a high-energy opening to set two [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-03-07.nak700.glassberg.motb.82370.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 23 songs; 179 min; rated 4.2/5 by 15 [1]
- **gd1981-03-07.128755.senn421.wise.minches.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 167 min [3]
- **gd81-03-07complete.aud-wise.senn421.22933.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 169 min; rated 3.68/5 by 28 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience tape sounds somewhat distant for a front-of-board claim, but fuller than the Nak 700 version, with restrained crowd noise; Reviewer laments that no clear soundboard exists for this show; Attendee says the recording is nicely balanced with little audience noise and sounds better than the live room did [8][9][10]
- **gd1981-03-07.174923.Bernstein.MasterCassettes.t-flac2496**: source not stated; 23 songs; 162 min [6]. Said about its sound: The taper's position seems centered, though the microphones used cannot be recalled [6]

## Around the show

- Attendee says the energy was so high that three in their party went missing at intermission until next morning [12]
- Reviewer says this Cole Field House show was their first Dead concert [14]
- Attendee sat front row by Jerry's mic; lights went out and the energy stayed high for about three hours [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-03-07.nak700.glassberg.motb.82370.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by A. Egert and C. Ladner; source: Nakamichi CM700's > Sony TC-D5M > MAC [1]. Also: Audience source with Senn 421 mics to Sony D5, then cassette master, CD, EAC and SHN; A tape flip in the Deal on disc two was patched with a crossfade from the Jim Wise recording [1]
- **gd1981-03-07.128755.senn421.wise.minches.flac16**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by David Minches; source: Recording by Jim Wise: Master Audience Cassette; 2 Sennheiser 421s> Sony D-5; Location: set up at the SBD; Transfer and FLAC encoding by David Minches; Dolby B… [3]
- **gd81-03-07complete.aud-wise.senn421.22933.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Sennheiser 421's [4]
- **gd1981-03-07.174923.Bernstein.MasterCassettes.t-flac2496**: taped by Master Cassettes Recorded by Jon Bernstein; transferred by Transfer & Mastered by Ray Ackerman Edited w/ add'l Mastering by Joe Noel October 07, 2025; source: ?? mics > ?? lead deck > ?? Deck > Master Cassettes [6]

- Poster by www.cahiersdumusique.com: [Grateful Dead's Most Underrated Year: 1981](http://www.cahiersdumusique.com/2018/10/grateful-deads-most-underrated-year-1981.html) [21]
